message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Daily sweep for the Products.txt list, covering the 24-hour window ending 2026-07-12 05:10 IST (2026-07-11 23:40 UTC). No credible, newly reported vulnerability was found that clearly maps to the monitored products during this window.

I reviewed fresh public CVE/advisory signals and vendor/security sources for the monitored list, including Cisco Nexus/UCS/Fabric Extender, SonicWall, FortiGate/FortiOS, Barracuda, Microsoft Windows/Office/Edge/.NET/PowerShell/Defender, Ubuntu, Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, PostgreSQL, MySQL/MSSQL, MongoDB-family components, Redis, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, OpenSSL, Apache HTTP Server/Tomcat, IIS, Nginx, VMware ESXi/vCenter/Tools, Grafana/Kibana/Prometheus/Graylog, SolarWinds/PRTG/Site24x7/Tenable Nessus, ESET/Cortex XDR/Imperva, WordPress/Yoast SEO/Advanced Custom Fields, Adobe Acrobat/Photoshop/Creative Cloud, Ubiquiti/UniFi, OpenSSH, Samba, ManageEngine, and the remaining products in Products.txt.

**Findings**

No relevant new vulnerabilities were confirmed in the last 24 hours.

**Possible matches needing review**

None. Fresh items found during the sweep were either outside the monitored product list, outside the 24-hour window, or not product vulnerabilities. Examples excluded from the digest include July 11 NVD entries for unrelated ImageMagick, Joomla extensions, and WordPress plugins not named in the monitored list; CISA KEV additions for Joomla extensions; and older Ubiquiti/UniFi, Chrome, Microsoft Defender, Ubuntu, and VMware items that were published before this run window.

Closing note: No immediate vulnerability-review action is recommended from this run based on the public sources checked. Continue normal patch monitoring for routine vendor updates and for any environment-specific exposure that may not appear in public advisories yet.
